actions.description: Startup item removal is guidance-only to avoid destructive deletion.
actions.guidance: Inspect each startup item, verify ownership and signature, then unload or remove only entries confirmed to be unauthorized.
actions.rollback_guidance: Keep a copy of any removed plist or executable before changing it.
actions.title: Investigate startup persistence

actions.description: Sharing changes can disrupt expected access, so this is guidance-only.
actions.guidance: Review enabled sharing services and share points in System Settings > General > Sharing, then disable anything not explicitly required.
actions.rollback_guidance: Re-enable required sharing services from System Settings.
actions.title: Review sharing configuration
